minimum_count_policy: Minimums require distinct, relevant identities with supported pre-cutoff report/static-version basis. Identity/time unresolved objects may be retained as unknown/pending but do not fill the two minimum-five quotas. An individual capability cell being unknown does not itself disqualify an otherwise identified, time-supported entity; all five capabilities need not exist in every framework.

network.follow_policy: Discover publicly accessible primary materials and bounded cross-checks; do not log in, pay, send messages or change network safety rules.

date_policy.entity_releases: Use actual official release published_at or explicit package distribution upload time with its original field role. Release title, tag name, repository created_at or fetch time does not alone prove a release date or capability availability.
date_policy.fixed_static_code: A fixed official commit and its recorded timestamp may identify a pre-cutoff static version. State this role; commit time does not prove first public availability, deployment, tested durability or an independent historical web archive. Do not call current docs the cutoff's latest without evidence.
date_policy.arxiv: Use official base-ID v1 Submitted as the adopted report submission basis; record the read vN Submitted separately and do not use post-cutoff revisions. Submitted is not asserted to prove actual first public visibility.
date_policy.journal: Prefer first_online; use explicit issue_only fallback only when no official online date can be established and retain that unknown. Do not substitute received/accepted/indexed/repository/fetch dates.
date_policy.conference_proceedings: Use an identified official proceedings publication year/date at its actual precision and state that role. Conference event dates or copyright text do not establish an exact first-online day; retain uncertainty rather than filling one.
date_policy.benchmark_protocol: Identify the actual official fixed document/repository version and its date role; related manuscript dates are separate. Do not use a README to claim unseen manuscript results.
date_policy.precision: Keep actual year/month/day precision; a year/month means its entire calendar interval. Confirm cutoff eligibility only if the supported interval is fully before cutoff; crossing/unknown/conflicting dates remain pending or unknown, not favorable guesses.
date_policy.timezone: Retain an actual aware timestamp and convert to Asia/Shanghai for cutoff. Date-only sources without a timezone keep their stated calendar date and disclose timezone unknown; do not assume UTC.
date_policy.current_carriers: Current retrieval can expose an identified pre-cutoff report/static version, but is not proof of publication-day bytes. If later changes affect the used claim, identify an applicable version or keep it unknown.

reading_and_evidence_boundary: At least five research works require complete relevant manuscript text or complete official benchmark protocol/main documentation. Excerpt/abstract and incomplete downloads support only observed facts. Evidence level, representativeness, identity/version deduplication, actual search/reading and semantic support require independent assessment; mechanically valid strings or URLs do not prove them.
